items.stimulus: These are the statutes and the judgments which ye shall keep in the land whither ye (are) crossing, thou and thy son and thy son's son.
accepted: אֵלֶּה הַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמְרוּ בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים שָׁמָּה אַתָּה וּבִנְךָ וּבֶן־בִּנְךָ

source.citation: Davidson, An Introductory Hebrew Grammar (22nd ed., 1923), exercise §30 C 7; McFadyen, Key to the Exercises (1924)
